entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ReadyToRun: `box T; isinst X` is not folded for exact value-type instantiations, so R2R code allocates #135892
  • Test failure: MutexTests IOException "'/tmp/.dotnet/shm/global' does not have the expected owner permissions" #135889
  • Test failure: System.Threading.Tests.MutexTests.NameOptionsApiCompatibilityTest #135888
  • MutexTests failing on Unix, browser and WASI after #135778 (default named-mutex scope change) #135887
  • release/8.0 is not building due to a MsQuic dependency warning-as-error. #135879
  • LdapConnection.Bind never times out on Linux when the server accepts the connection but does not respond: LDAP_OPT_TIMEOUT is never set #135874
  • LdapConnection.SendRequest does not honour Timeout on 64-bit Linux: LDAP_TIMEVAL is 8 bytes, but libldap reads a 16-byte struct timeval #135873
  • [R2R] Crossgen2 AllMethodsOnType compiles every method on referenced generic instantiations, causing composite size explosion (wasmtime OOM on WASI) #135872
    12.0.0
  • [Interpreter] A thread abort raised again after a catch skips the catch of the enclosing try #135871
  • Access violation in UnwindInfoTable::UnpublishUnwindInfoForMethod when a DynamicMethod with a discarded JIT attempt is collected #135870
  • Drop support for x64 simulators (iossimulator-x64 / tvossimulator-x64) #135864
  • HttpContentHeaders.ContentLength throws OBjectDisposedException under certain conditions #135859
  • [aw] Need to setup a mechanism to periodically upgrade gh-aw version used by the repo #135856
  • .NET 11 thread pool: multiplexed clients leave cores idle, 30–45% lower throughput than .NET 10 (RC1 and RC2) #135855
  • [tests][Apple] XUnitWrapperGenerator skips conditional bodies for iossimulator TargetOS #135849
  • [CoreCLR][iOS] Cached interface dispatch uses a retired collectible target after ALC unload #135848
  • [Perf] Linux/arm64: 1 Regression on 10/7/2026 11:56:00 PM +00:00 #135868
  • JIT: Incorrect displacement for VPMULUDQ with embedded broadcast #135844
    12.0.0
  • QuicStreamTests.ReadsClosedFinishes test failure in CI #135843
  • Unix enumeration returns "." and ".." as FileInfo when readdir reports DT_REG, despite ReturnSpecialDirectories=false #135832
  • Proposal: Unique, reversable name mangling / sanitization for ilc and crossgen2 symbols #135831
